title: Contract pack
applies: unless expressly not applicable on documented review
mandatory_tasks: Compare the draft contract, sale memorandum, property particulars and title identifiers for consistency
Record parties, price, deposit, tenure, property extent, included items, VAT wording and vacant-possession/occupation terms where relevant
Review incorporated standard conditions, every special condition, completion mechanics, default consequences and any notice provisions
Identify missing papers, non-standard obligations, amendments needed and points requiring client or lender instructions
Prepare a clause-referenced contract issues and amendments schedule for lawyer review
conditional_tasks: For auction or deadline-led transactions, extract the actual completion date, notice mechanics, deposit terms and any accelerated obligations from the pack
For new build, leasehold, company, mixed-use or VAT-sensitive transactions, add the relevant profile and specialist module review
Where the borrower has lender representation, check contractual terms against the actual offer and lender instructions and record any referral
documents_required: amendments, side letters or incentives where supplied
deadlines: Calculate from relevant contract, statute, lender offer and documentary dates
risks: onerous unapproved contract default or uncertain property extent
client_confirmation: Document express instructions when risks, cost or irrevocable steps arise
lender_reporting: Use actual lender instructions; not automatically required for every transaction
completion_criteria: all material terms understood and instructions obtained
expected_outputs: Parties, property, title, tenure, price and deposit cross-check
Clause-referenced terms and special-condition summary
Material deviations, liabilities, deadlines and default consequences
Missing/referenced documents and targeted questions
Agreed amendments and client instructions record
Lender referral/decision record where required
Exchange and completion mechanics summary for lawyer review
review_prompts: Does the contract identify the same parties, title/property extent and tenure as the instructions and evidence?
Which incorporated, varied or special terms depart from the expected transaction or create unusual cost, risk or timing?
Are all referenced documents available and reviewed, or explicitly listed as missing?
What must the client understand or decide before an irreversible step?
What lender approval or disclosure is required by the actual instructions?
escalation_triggers: Property, party, title or price mismatch
Unreviewed incorporated document or material non-standard obligation
Unclear deposit, completion, default, notice or vacant-possession arrangement
Possible VAT, incentive, linked transaction or lender-security issue
Contract deadline that may expire before required advice, evidence or approval

title: Title investigation
applies: unless expressly not applicable on documented review
mandatory_tasks: Identify and review the correct current register and title plan, or establish the unregistered title evidence chain
Reconcile registered proprietor/seller, title number, class, extent and tenure against the contract and physical/property evidence
Analyse relevant property, proprietorship and charges entries and each referenced or filed instrument
Map rights, reservations, covenants, easements, leases, charges, restrictions, notices and other interests to their evidence and practical effect
Track each title defect, missing deed, consent, discharge or third-party dependency with a proposed evidence-based cure
conditional_tasks: For unregistered title, build the epitome and assess root, land charges and evidence gaps under the unregistered title module
For leasehold, estate, shared ownership, development or auction matters, add the relevant specialist module and profile checks
For lender representation, assess title against actual lender requirements and record report/approval status
documents_required: current official register and title plan or complete unregistered epitome
all relevant filed deeds and referenced instruments
evidence addressing charges, restrictions, rights and consents
relevant leases, transfers, variations and prior conveyances as applicable
deadlines: Calculate from relevant contract, statute, lender offer and documentary dates
risks: material defect, defective root, unresolved charge or third-party right
client_confirmation: Document express instructions when risks, cost or irrevocable steps arise
lender_reporting: Use actual lender instructions; not automatically required for every transaction
completion_criteria: title findings supported by source evidence
expected_outputs: Title identity, class, tenure and extent reconciliation with source locators
Property, proprietorship and charges register analysis or unregistered evidence-chain summary
Rights, covenants, easements, restrictions, charges and notices schedule
Plan/physical extent and access discrepancies requiring investigation
Missing instruments and defect/cure tracker with responsible party
Lender title-reporting and approval items where applicable
Draft title conclusions and residual assumptions for human review
review_prompts: Does each title conclusion trace to the current register, filed instrument or other identified evidence?
Are plans and descriptions consistent, and what cannot be verified from supplied material?
What third-party rights, restrictions or obligations affect use, access, transfer, mortgage or registration?
Is there evidence for discharge, consent or compliance, rather than an unsupported assertion?
What remains uncertain and what document or enquiry could resolve it?
escalation_triggers: Uncertain ownership, title extent, class or root
Unresolved charge, restriction, adverse right or missing instrument
Material plan, access, boundary or contract discrepancy
Evidence does not establish required discharge, consent or compliance
Potential title defect affecting use, marketability, lender security or registration

title: Searches and enquiries
applies: unless expressly not applicable on documented review
mandatory_tasks: Create a search plan based on jurisdiction, property, transaction profile, tenure, client instructions and actual lender requirements
Record each search as not considered, not required with rationale, ordered, received, reviewed or superseded; capture provider, scope, result date and limitations
Compare search results with title, contract, property forms, inspection information and other supplied evidence
Raise precise, numbered enquiries tied to the search/document source and track response, evidence and unresolved status
Assess whether a result requires client advice, specialist input, insurance consideration or lender referral without treating any as automatic clearance
conditional_tasks: Add local, drainage, environmental, highways, planning, mining, flood, commons/village green, chancel or other enquiries only where relevant to the location, property and risk assessment
For leasehold, new build, commercial, rural or development matters, use the applicable profile and specialist module to identify additional searches and enquiries
Where a search is not obtained, record who made that decision, the stated rationale, client instruction and any lender position
documents_required: search plan and search order/receipt records
search results with scope, date and limitations
title and contract documents used for cross-checking
enquiry schedule and replies with source attachments
client/lender decisions or specialist reports where relevant
deadlines: Calculate from relevant contract, statute, lender offer and documentary dates
risks: search defect not resolved or required lender approval absent
client_confirmation: Document express instructions when risks, cost or irrevocable steps arise
lender_reporting: Use actual lender instructions; not automatically required for every transaction
completion_criteria: results assessed and material issues resolved or formally accepted
expected_outputs: Search plan with each search status, rationale, provider/scope and result date
Search limitation and adverse-result register with source locators
Cross-check findings against title, contract and other evidence
Numbered enquiry log with response/evidence and unresolved status
Client advice, specialist referral and lender referral/decision records
Outstanding actions with owner and relevant transaction deadline
review_prompts: Which searches are appropriate for this property and transaction, and what is the recorded basis?
What is outside the search provider’s scope or date coverage?
Do search results conflict with title, contract or other evidence?
Does each material result have a response, advice path, or expressly documented unresolved status?
Has an omitted search or accepted risk been documented with client and lender implications?
escalation_triggers: Adverse or inconsistent result affecting access, use, value, safety, planning or security
Search missing, out of scope, stale for the transaction, or subject to material limitation
No adequate response/evidence for a material enquiry
Client proposes to proceed with an unresolved risk or waived search
Lender approval or specialist advice may be required but is not evidenced

title: Leasehold/estate management
applies: unless expressly not applicable on documented review
mandatory_tasks: Review the lease and variations for term, rent/review, repair, insurance, use, alienation, alterations, service and enforcement provisions
Reconcile the lease plan, demise, rights, reservations and obligations against title and contract evidence
Review the management information for service charges, reserve funds, accounts, budgets, planned works, insurance, arrears and disputes where provided
Identify required notices, certificates, consents, licences, deeds, certificates of compliance and fees from the lease, title and actual lender requirements
Identify relevant building-safety status and evidence questions; do not infer status from building type or a single certificate
Track missing management, landlord, resident-management or building-safety evidence and the party responsible for obtaining it
conditional_tasks: For a flat, block, estate, shared ownership or managed development, assess the relevant management structure and transaction-profile checks
Where works, major charges, disputes, insurance claims, arrears or building-safety matters are indicated, request the underlying evidence and seek specialist review as appropriate
Where lender security is involved, check the actual lease requirements and lender instructions and record any referral or approval
documents_required: lease and all variations, deeds and plans
LPE1/TA7 or current management pack and supporting accounts/budgets
insurance schedule and relevant claims information
licences, consents, certificates, notices and fee schedule as applicable
building-safety material and correspondence relevant to the property where applicable
deadlines: Calculate from relevant contract, statute, lender offer and documentary dates
risks: registration restriction or missing essential landlord certificate
client_confirmation: Document express instructions when risks, cost or irrevocable steps arise
lender_reporting: Use actual lender instructions; not automatically required for every transaction
expected_outputs: Lease term, rent, review, repair, use, alienation and enforcement summary with clause references
Demise, rights, reservations and lease/title/contract consistency check
Service-charge, reserve, budget, planned-works, insurance, arrears and dispute summary
Consents, notices, certificates, deeds, compliance steps, fees and responsible-party tracker
Building-safety evidence/status questions and unresolved items where relevant
Client/lender advice and referral records tied to evidence
Outstanding management-pack items and actions with owner/deadline
review_prompts: Which lease provisions affect ownership, occupation, transfer, mortgage, costs or future use?
Are the lease, plan, register and contract consistent about the property and rights?
What do the management documents show, and which periods or documents are missing?
Which post-completion or registration steps require a landlord, manager, resident body or other third party?
What building-safety evidence is available, what does it actually establish, and what remains unanswered?
escalation_triggers: Unclear or short lease term, rent review, use, repair, insurance or alienation position
Material inconsistency between lease, plan, register and contract
Unquantified major works, substantial disputed charges, material arrears or insurance concerns
Required consent, certificate, deed or notice path unclear or unavailable
Building-safety evidence incomplete, inconsistent or potentially material to occupation, value or lender security
